chapter: Los Angeles 1947-48, Rock Island and bebop in New York
title: Back in Los Angeles in 1947-48, substituting with Billy Eckstine's band
summary: He subbed for two nights at Joe Morris's Plantation.

story.theme_name: Charlie Parker, Dizzy and the bebop revolution
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Well anyway, where did we go from here, let's see. We've done the New York scene. Oh, there -- I came back out here to Los Angeles and stayed '47 and '48 and I had an occasion to sit in with -- not sit in but substitute Billy Eckst and his big band, Tommy Potter had pneumonia. So I went out and substituted for two nights. And I couldn't play but two nights. The second night I pulled a callous off my finger trying to be heard through this big band. This big band, band.
Joe Morrison's Plantation. He had names galore in that band. And then I enrolled in City College to further my music.
